## Pareto API

Pareto is a large language model by Pareto, available on the Venice API as `pareto`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Pareto is a blended model that runs several frontier models in parallel on every request and returns one answer. It accepts text and image inputs.

### Pareto API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pareto` | Standard | Anonymized | $1.00 / $4.00 per 1M |

### Pareto specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Pareto |
| Released | Oct 14, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Beta |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |

### How to use the Pareto API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "pareto"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "pareto",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
